title: Parts Credits tab shows Vendor, Date and Processed by filters
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Parts pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Parts area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Parts area and go to the Returns page.
3. Look at the filter buttons shown above the credits table.
expected: 1. The Credits tab shows three filter buttons: Vendor, Date and Processed by.
2. The table shows the columns: Credit Memo Number, Vendor, Work Order, Vendor Invoice, Date, Processed By, Total Cost and Notes.
3. A blue Create Credit button is shown at the top right.
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11884-16885 (Parts filters); design-notes.md §B.5 #5
notes: Design-only (chip + column presence). Option lists and apply behaviour pending Branko's PRD.
